title: Threat register view
description: Ephemeral derived Insight ViewModel from traust-core's threat-register view: the scope's standing threats from each repository's latest completed threat model as of as_of, ranked, with class-closing quick wins, tenant boundaries weakest first and the open doc variances. Threats, mitigations and boundaries are Core's projections of the threat-model documents, not the documents. Not a persisted artifact or SQL projection. Every serialized field is present, nullable ones included; lists are never null. JSON Schema checks structure and ranges, not arithmetic across fields.

as_of.description: The point in time the threat models are read at: the filter's, else when the view was built.

repository_urls.description: Every repository in scope by id, with its raw registered URL.

models.description: Threat models the threats come from.

threats.description: Every threat, by band (critical first, unbanded last), then status, repository URL and label.

quick_wins.description: Class-closing xs or s mitigations over unmitigated critical or high threats, one per model and mitigation, critical first, then by mitigation text.

tenant_boundaries.description: Tenant-facing interfaces, weakest first (then most complex, most open threats, repository URL, boundary id).

open_variances.description: The scope's open doc variances (official-docs claims that code evidence contradicts), oldest verified first.

ranked_threat.description: A threat with the band it ranks by.

band.description: Its stated OWASP severity, else the rating policy's crosswalk of its legacy likelihood and impact; null when it has neither.

crosswalked.description: Whether the band came from the legacy crosswalk.

threat.description: One threat as its threat model states it.

label.description: The model's threat id (T1, T2, ...), raw.

actor.description: The weakest position, the one scoring reads.

severity.description: The stated OWASP rating; null until re-rated.

likelihood.description: The threat-likelihood registry's legacy label; null when not stated.

impact.description: The threat-impact registry's legacy label; null when not stated.

evidence.description: Evidence anchors, raw; empty when modelled but not evidenced.

techniques.description: The ATT&CK techniques the threat cites, raw: a citation need not be a live or even well-formed technique id.

boundary_ids.description: The tenant boundaries naming it, raw.

isolation_review_ref.description: The first naming boundary's isolation-review artifact reference, raw; null when none.

linddun.description: Whether it is a LINDDUN privacy-overlay row.

closes_class.description: Whether it closes the threat's class (yes, partial, no), raw as the model states it.

effort.description: Its size, raw as the model states it (a legacy XS is preserved); null when unsized.

blocked_external.description: Whether something outside the repository blocks it; null when unknown.

quick_win.description: A class-closing xs or s mitigation and the unmitigated critical or high threats it covers.

effort.description: The mitigation-effort registry values that normalize to xs or s, as the model states them.

covers.description: The labels of the threats it covers.

ranked_boundary.description: A tenant boundary with what ranks it.

weakness.description: Each failed dimension weighs 2 (a result outside the isolation-check-result vocabulary counts as failed), each partial one 1.

failed.description: Dimensions stated no, or with a result outside the vocabulary.

open_threats.description: Labels of the open threats it tags.

boundary.description: One tenant-facing interface as a multi-tenant threat model states it.

kind.description: Raw as the model states it.

exposure.description: Raw as the model states it.

complexity.description: The interface-complexity registry's level; null when not stated.

dimensions.description: Each isolation dimension's result as the model states it, raw.

doc_variance.description: One official-docs claim that code evidence contradicts (a doc-variance register record).

kind.description: The doc-variance-kind registry's kind; null when the record states none.

disposition.description: Always open: the register lists open variances only.

artifact.description: The doc-variance register artifact the record is in.
